description: GPU smoke-test prompts. They produce no experiment data and are excluded from every prompt pool: holdout, primary, secondary, controls and reserves.

prompts.text: Close-up of a woman laughing softly, warm window light, shallow depth of field.
Close-up of two hands picking up a glass of water from a wooden table.
